rca_of_the_issue: Original age-gate bypass was caused by ProfileUpdate omitting dob, so body.model_dump(exclude_unset=True) never contained dob and the calc_age branch never ran. Original completion bug was caused by stats being fetched only on mount. The current patch addresses both: dob is present in ProfileUpdate and saveField refetches /profile/me/stats after each auto-save. No mocked APIs were used in the tested flows.
